questions.title: Which state will MAGA Inc. target with its first major general-election advertising buy of the 2026 midterms?
questions.background: MAGA Inc. is a super PAC associated with Donald Trump. Its advertising commitments can indicate which congressional races Republicans consider strategically important.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : MAGA Inc.'s public announcement and corresponding Federal Election Commission filing, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting. Resolution Rule : Resolve to the state targeted by the advertising commitment identified as MAGA Inc.'s first major general-election advertising expenditure of the 2026 midterm cycle. Resolution occurs when the commitment is publicly announced, regardless of when the advertisements begin running. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the U.S. state where the advertisements are scheduled to run.
questions.current_reasoning: Reordering Texas back ahead of Michigan on 2026-09-01/02 reporting (CNN Politics, NOTUS, Semafor, AP News, Daily Beast/Politico, The Desk/AdImpact). First, the primary reason Michigan edged ahead on Aug 30—VP JD Vance's Aug 31 MAGA Inc.-funded Sterling Heights rally—passed without any Michigan ad buy announcement. John Kennedy, Sen. Lifting Texas (0.32 -> 0.38) over Michigan (0.34 -> 0.28, still a strong #2 given MAGA Inc.'s Michigan launch and pre-Sept 11 El-Sayed messaging) while holding North Carolina (0.10), Georgia (0.07), and Ohio (0.04) (sum = 0.87).
